subject: Finova integration kickoff — access & tenant setup
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: karthik_iyer@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Kickoff: Finova integration & access setup

Laura —

Congrats, the Finova deal is moving to implementation (see attached handoff_summary.pdf). Quick context: Finova is targeting a pilot for payments auth and will need a dedicated project, API keys scoped for production, and at least one service account during evaluation. Sales asked me to loop you in to own tenant provisioning and access.

Key asks from sales:
- Create the Finova tenant and a separate dev project for the pilot.
- Provision one temporary API key for their PoC and define rotation plan.
- Pre-configure roles for Product Manager + Integration Engineer + Security Reviewer.

Proposed kickoff windows next week (all PDT):
- Tue Apr 7: 10:00–10:45
- Wed Apr 8: 14:00–14:45

Attaching the one-page handoff. Can you confirm whether we should enable IP allowlisting and SSO for the pilot or wait until production?

Thanks — happy to jump on the kickoff if helpful.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 02 Apr 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Finova integration & access setup

Thanks for the handoff, Stephanie — pulling this across. Attaching an access_matrix.csv and a sample invite we use for customers. High-level plan below; I’ll own tenant creation and initial invites.

Plan (owner / ETA):
- Tenant & project structure: create "finova-prod" tenant and "finova-poc" project (Owner: laura_bennett) — ETA: 2026-04-03 COB
- API key: generate a scoped, time-limited API key for PoC with token usage policy (Owner: karthik_iyer) — ETA: 2026-04-03 16:00 PDT
- Roles & invites: create 3 role templates (Product Manager, Integration Engineer, Security Reviewer) and send invites (Owner: laura_bennett) — ETA: 2026-04-04
- IP allowlist & SSO: recommend enabling IP allowlist for the PoC; SSO to be scheduled for production. (Owner: laura_bennett; advise: monica_patel)
- Documentation & MI: share pre-provisioned keys and the minimal onboarding checklist via Drive link, and create a HubSpot activity (Owner: monica_patel)

Quick notes:
- For the PoC key we will set a 30-day TTL and require rotation before production. If Finova requests client-side rotation automation, we can provide a small script.
- We’ll include an audit log export for their security reviewer and prepare SOC2 summary links if requested.

Action items for the kickoff meeting: confirm which Finova users need owner vs viewer rights, agree on retention/SLA expectations for PoC, and confirm whether Finova wants our managed KMS for keys or client-side KMS.

I’ll reach out to the Finova contacts once Monica confirms the kickoff slot.

Success milestones I want on the kickoff agenda:
- Tenant created and PoC project able to call the API (smoke test)
- PoC key issued and validated by Finova engineering
- Security reviewer has audit logs and SOC2 summary
- Timeline to production (high-level) and any blockers

Proposed kickoff: Tue Apr 7, 10:00–10:45 PDT (matches one of Stephanie's windows). I will send the calendar invite once Samira confirms.

HubSpot task: https://app.hubspot.com/task/9876543 (created)

From: Samira Khan <samira@finova.com>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com; Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@finova.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Finova integration & access setup

Laura / Monica —

Thanks for the quick follow-up and the plan. Tue Apr 7 at 10:00 PDT works for us. I’m copying our integration lead, Alex Thompson. Attendees from Finova:
- Samira Khan (Product Lead) — samira@finova.com
- Alex Thompson (Integration Engineer) — alex.thompson@finova.com
- Priya Desai (Security) — priya.desai@finova.com (will join if possible)

A couple of security-related questions up front:
- For PoC keys, do you support IP allowlisting on a per-key basis? We prefer that for pilot traffic.
- What is the recommended approach for key rotation during the PoC? Do you provide client libraries for automated rotation or should we handle via our CI?

Additionally, could you share your SOC2 summary and any pen-test SLA we can reference before the kickoff?

We look forward to the call — please send a calendar invite and the Zoom link.

—
Samira Khan
Head of Product, Finova
samira@finova.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Samira Khan <samira@finova.com>, Alex Thompson <alex.thompson@finova.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 03 Apr 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Kickoff: Finova integration & access setup

Hi Samira / Alex —

Great — confirmed: Tue Apr 7, 10:00–10:45 PDT. Zoom link: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=finova. I’ve added the calendar invite and attached a short kickoff-agenda.pdf with objectives and required pre-reads.

Quick answers to your questions:
- IP allowlisting: yes, we can enable per-key allowlisting for the PoC. We’ll add an allowlist during key creation and share the instructions so your team can verify.
- Key rotation: for the PoC we’ll issue a 30-day TTL key and provide a rotation helper script. For production we recommend using KMS-backed keys and automated rotation via our SDK/CI integration.
- SOC2 / pen-test: Monica attached a SOC2 summary to the Drive folder and I’ve included a link in the invite. If Priya wants the full report under an NDA, we can start that process.

Next steps before the call (owners):
- Laura: Create tenant + finova-poc project and pre-provision PoC key (ETA: 2026-04-03 COB)
- Karthik: Prepare key scopes and rotation script (ETA: 2026-04-03 16:00 PDT)
- Monica: Send calendar invite and HubSpot update (ETA: 2026-04-03 12:00 PDT)

Looking forward to the kickoff. If anything changes please flag.

—
Laura Bennett
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
